meta.notes: Runs natively (genai-native gn-diffusion p-h3-image/edit): picture 1 is the one edited, up to seven references follow (<Picture 2> ... in the prompt). Each picture goes to the encoder at 1 MP and through the VAE within the output's area (4 MP when no size is asked) as reference tokens at t = 0.999. A short instruction gets "Edit <Picture 1>. " in front, as PrunaAI's PH3ImageConditioning does. 8 fixed steps, no CFG.
